notes: Public-API coverage for a timed federation save at logical time 6, a queued timestamp-8 explicit-source regional attribute update, restore, independent Flush Queue Requests at two subscribers, and post-restore retraction fanout. A fresh MinGW build and native HLA_EVOKED Catch2 run pass 165 assertions. The Reflect Attribute Values region designator is a copy of the update-region realization; the test therefore queries the callback-scoped receiver copy during the callback and verifies its dimensions and original source bounds instead of requiring its handle to equal the publisher's source handle. Installed-package C++ primary/contract scenarios passed under HLA_EVOKED with HLAinteger64Time and HLAfloat64Time. Java provider runtime, process-restart interoperability, and formal conformance remain unverified.
